breakfast.name: Overnight oats with protein
ingredients: 1–2 scoops protein powder, or 1/2 cup Greek yogurt in the morning
steps: Divide oats, milk, and protein into 2 jars the night before.
Refrigerate overnight.
Stir and top with cinnamon and berries when you eat.

lunch.name: Berry spinach protein smoothie
ingredients: 1–1.5 cups plain Greek yogurt, or 2 scoops protein powder
2 tbsp almond butter or ground flax
steps: Add everything to the blender, one batch per person if the blender is small.
Blend until smooth, thinning with more almond milk to taste.

dinner.name: Sheet-pan cod, asparagus and tomatoes
ingredients: 2 cod fillets (haddock or tilapia is fine)
steps: Heat oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan.
Toss asparagus and tomatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper, and roast 8 minutes.
Pat fish dry, rub with remaining oil and seasoning, and nestle on the pan with lemon slices.
Roast 10–12 minutes more, until the fish flakes.
Squeeze the remaining lemon over before serving.

dinner.name: Turkey and zucchini skillet
ingredients: Salt, pepper, garlic powder, cumin, paprika
steps: Cook turkey in 1 tbsp oil with salt, pepper, cumin, and paprika until no pink remains.
Transfer to a plate.
Sauté onion and pepper in the remaining oil for 3–4 minutes.
Add zucchini and cook 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return the turkey, toss, and wilt in spinach if using.

dinner.name: Flank steak fajita bowl
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak or sirloin strips
4 cups shredded lettuce or mixed greens
steps: Season the steak and rest it 5 minutes while you slice the vegetables.
Sear in 1 tbsp oil over high heat, 3–4 minutes per side for medium.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice thin against the grain.
Cook peppers and onion in the remaining oil for 5–7 minutes.
Pile greens in bowls, top with steak and vegetables, and squeeze lime over.

dinner.name: Baked salmon, green beans and cucumber
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil plus 1 tbsp lemon juice, for the salad
1.5 tbsp olive oil for the pan
steps: Heat oven to 400°F.
Toss green beans with 1 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper, and roast 8 minutes.
Push the beans aside, add the salmon, drizzle with the remaining oil, and season.
Bake 10–12 minutes, until the salmon flakes.
Toss the cucumber with oil, lemon, salt, and pepper, and serve alongside.

dinner.name: Roast pork tenderloin and sweet potato
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil plus 1 tbsp balsamic or lemon
steps: Heat oven to 425°F.
Toss sweet potato with 1 tbsp oil and seasoning, and roast 10 minutes.
Rub the pork with the remaining oil and seasoning, add it to the pan, and roast 18–22 minutes more, to 145°F.
Rest the pork 5 minutes, then slice.
Toss the salad with dressing. Pack leftover pork for midweek.
